scorecard.rationale: The oral clove study's anxiety-labelled table corresponds to Beck depression methods and has no separate anxiety test. A Parkinson multi-odor trial reports anxiety changes but did not isolate eugenol or ground clove. The frozen direction remains unresolved. The original postinfectious study uses eugenol within a four-odor program and measures olfaction, parosmia and quality of life. It gives no eugenol-specific anxiety value or ground-clove result.
